title: Fix add-to-album endpoint: media_id type handling
description: POST /api/pixelfed/v1/collections/{id}/items returns empty response (server error). Likely the media_id in the request body needs to accept both string and integer (Pixelfed sends strings, our test sent integer). Also need to verify album ownership check works correctly.
close_reason: Both bugs fixed. max_attachments enforced with 422 rejection. add-to-album accepts string or integer media_id.
